step_4: Performance mismatches are linked to Reno's loss-based nature. step_7: Predictive analysis suggests that a delay-based approach will cap the CWND before the Wi-Fi buffer saturates, reducing the average RTT toward the 90 ms target and smoothing the throughput by avoiding the aggressive sawtooth drops of Reno, thereby improving the QoE score.
